trials.summary: Trial 01 (sw=0.409, h_f=1.837, h_s=3.354, cap=0.156): objective 0.1243 +/- 0.0809 above the exp5 honest level; 0 diverged cells, gamma finite on all 8 (mu rel-RMSE 58.1%, gamma rel-RMSE 27.3%).
trials.key_insight: Moderate sigma damping (sw 0.41) + flat sigma kernel (h_s 3.35) keeps gamma finite and divergence-free, but mu stays strongly biased, so the score design alone does not yet beat the frozen exp5 level.

protocol.model: series-21 (17g) model on REAL data; mu reward = Anuar's per-run likelihood (MU_REWARD=loglik_mean), mu score denominator = per-experiment sigma_prop (MU_SCORE=sigma_prop)
protocol.question: experiment_6 - score-DESIGN campaign for failure mode #8: the learning-rate schedule is FROZEN to the experiment_5 winner (trial_21) and the campaign tunes the sigma_fit KDE channel (damping + bandwidths) and a relative gamma trust region.

frozen_schedule.note: experiment_5 winning trial (trial_21); the schedule is a plateau and is NOT searched here

protocol.no_clipping: CLIP = inf AND parameter clamps removed (mu/gamma unbounded)

divergence_guard.note: STOP the experiment and record diverged/diverged_at if a parameter leaves this band (guards the photon-count blow-up)

protocol.objective: T-weighted mean of CAP-capped per-cell rel-sq errors; err_i = min(rel_sq_i, CAP=1.0); w(T) = 0.25 + 0.75*T/100; objective = sum(w*err)/sum(w)
frozen: Anuar's mu reward (loglik_mean) + sigma_prop score denominator
tunable: gamma_rel_cap float  0.0 .. 0.5   (per-step relative gamma trust region; 0=off)
protocol.success_bar: beat the experiment_5 honest level (objective ~0.108-0.113, best 0.1074) on the same T-weighted capped metric, with gamma finite on all 8 cells and fewer/zero diverged cells
